question: Net Canadian DAF disbursements of DAF-to-DAF and DAF-to-foundation transfers: join the CRA qualified-donees files (2024, 2025 releases; donor BN to donee BN and amount) to the panel's 5860=Y sponsor list, sum gifts from DAF sponsors to other DAF sponsors, and recompute payout on prior-year DAF assets on the US netted definition
conclusion_affected: Canada vs US payout comparison (Canada 13.3% gross on prior-year assets vs US 22.8% netted)
rationale: Line 5864 includes transfers to other DAF sponsors and foundations (Blumberg-Pasha flag it); the qualified-donees file names donee BNs, so a sponsor-to-sponsor matrix is computable, though it is charity-wide rather than DAF-only

question: Re-run the Canadian DAF panel when the 2025 List of charities release is complete (after mid-2027) and track 5860 answer churn: 56 charities with $0.84bn of 2024 DAF assets (incl. Nicola Wealth, Edmonton CF, Ottawa CF) have no 2025 return yet, and 167 that answered Y in 2024 answered N in 2025
conclusion_affected: Canadian DAF asset growth 2024-2025 (+11.6% on current releases) and the reliability of the 5860 universe
rationale: The 2025 release is a lower bound; Y-to-N churn suggests line 5860 is answered inconsistently by small charities

question: Compare sponsor DAF payout with the charity-level disbursement quota: read Schedule 8 (DQ) rows from the CRA 2024/2025 releases for the top-20 DAF sponsors and test whether any sponsor meets the 5% DQ only through non-DAF spending or carry-forwards
conclusion_affected: Whether a sponsor-level floor binds on Canadian DAF programs (precedent for US payout debate)
rationale: Median same-year DAF payout at sponsors with >= C$10m DAF assets is 7.3% (2025 release) and Winnipeg Foundation is 5.5%; DQ uses average investment property, not lines 5862-5864

question: Watch for the amending instrument or exposure draft of the giving fund guidelines (6%, 3-year smoothing): poll the legislation.gov.au API for new compilations of F2022L00184 and F2019L01227 and new titles containing 'Giving Fund'; record whether smoothing and the 6% floor apply per fund or per sub-fund
conclusion_affected: Payout-floor precedent; whether Australia regulates sub-funds (DAF accounts) individually
rationale: As at 2026-11-19 only the 2022 PuAF and 2019 PAF guidelines are in force, unamended; the rename to 'giving funds' commenced 2026-10-01 through Act No. 86 of 2026 Sch 7 without any rate change
